key_facts: Normal cerebral hemispheres should have symmetric cortical gyri and sulci with preserved gray-white matter differentiation.
The subcortical white matter is normally uniform in signal and should not show focal T2/FLAIR hyperintensity or mass effect.
The midline interhemispheric fissure should be centered without shift, compression, or abnormal extra-axial collection.
Brain MRI abnormalities may be described as focal, diffuse, symmetric, asymmetric, cortical, subcortical, or extra-axial depending on location and extent.
